issues.title: Unavailable backend validation obscured permanent graph-type rejection
issues.resolution: Algorithm request validation now validates graph identity and graph-type compatibility before backend availability. Hypergraph plus LOCAL_CUDA returns INVALID_GRAPH_TYPE.

issues.title: Explicit CUDA language could enter the OpenMP-only delegated planner
issues.resolution: Deterministic routing now rejects explicit CUDA/GPU execution with BACKEND_UNAVAILABLE and states that no OpenMP substitution, job, or GPU process occurred.

issues.title: Shortest-path matcher missed general and hyphenated use-GPU wording
issues.resolution: The deterministic topic matcher now recognizes general/hyphenated shortest-path phrasing and the explicit use verb while preserving read-only and execution gates.
